description: Current violation ledger for the REGISTERED PREDICATES of tools/naming-convention-rules.json only. Each entry is an occurrence that one of those predicates rejects and that the owning batch is not yet allowed to rename; it is keyed by an exact (file, RFC 6901 pointer, name) triple. This file says nothing about naming contracts enforced by registry closure, schema type or human review: rule-contract coverage is tracked in tools/naming-rule-coverage-matrix.json, and an empty ledger here does NOT mean the naming contract as a whole is closed. Entries are internal debt: they MUST NOT claim an external anchor, and the lint rejects new, ambiguous or stale rows.
closure_requirement: entries must be empty before the registered-predicate rename batches are closed; predicate-ledger closure is not rule-contract closure, which is measured by tools/naming-rule-coverage-matrix.json
